PlanAnnotations__Description: Configuration for the floor plan annotation layer - the text markup that sits over a plan cut. Annotations are stored per floor plan inside the project's TrueVision__ProjectData__.json, nested within PresentationMode__SavedCameraScenes, so they ride the existing R2 dev-key sync path. Text size is expressed in real millimetres so labels scale with the drawing exactly as CAD text does. All distance values are integer millimetres.

PlanAnnotations__Text__Config.PlanAnnotations__Text__Description: Default appearance of a newly placed annotation. Weights map to the three Open Sans faces the app already loads from CDN: 300 Light, 400 Regular, 600 SemiBold. No other weight will render correctly.

PlanAnnotations__Layer__Config.PlanAnnotations__Layer__Description: The annotation layer is a DOM overlay above the canvas, not Three.js geometry. PlaneOffsetBelowCameraMm records the notional height the layer represents between the camera and the cut, so a future canvas-plane renderer for image export can reproduce the same placement. MinRenderedPx hides labels that have zoomed too small to read rather than drawing unreadable specks.

PlanAnnotations__Interaction__Config.PlanAnnotations__Interaction__Descriptio: Editing behaviour. A single click and drag moves a label; a double click opens the in-situ editor. DragThresholdPx stops a slightly shaky click from being read as a drag and nudging the label.

PlanAnnotations__Hotkeys__Config.PlanAnnotations__Hotkeys__Description: Keyboard shortcuts available while a floor plan is being marked up. These are scoped to annotation editing and are bound only while it is on - they are deliberately NOT registered with the global Na__Hotkeys__Manager, which handles unmodified view-switching keys and ignores Ctrl combinations by design. Key values are matched case-insensitively against KeyboardEvent.key.

PlanAnnotations__Labels__Config.PlanAnnotations__Labels__Description: Wording for the annotation toolbar shown while a plan is being marked up in developer mode.
PlanAnnotations__Labels__Config.PlanAnnotations__Labels__PlaceHint: Click the plan to place the label.
PlanAnnotations__Labels__Config.PlanAnnotations__Labels__EditHint: Double-click to edit, drag to move.
PlanAnnotations__Labels__Config.PlanAnnotations__Labels__NoSelectionHint: Select a label to change its size or weight.
PlanAnnotations__Labels__Config.PlanAnnotations__Labels__ShortcutsHint: Ctrl+C copy, Ctrl+V paste, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Y redo, Del removes.
